bagPolicy.summary: The updated 2026 policy allows bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches and clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches; guests and bags may be searched. Backpacks, fanny packs and larger bags are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The nearly 20-acre lot is across Stockyards Boulevard east of Cooper’s BBQ. Published rates are $7 Monday–Wednesday, $10 Thursday and $15 Friday–Sunday, plus fees; Friday and Saturday valet is $20 plus fees.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ does not publish a specific rideshare pickup or drop-off area.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The onsite restaurant sells barbecue, burgers, catfish, appetizers, desserts and drinks. Entry to the club is required even if you only plan to eat.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The main lot has 22 accessible parking spaces and charges the usual parking fee. Contact the box office about a particular show’s accessible arrangements.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The current venue FAQ does not publish a general rule about re-entering after leaving a concert.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Concert tickets may be held at will call for pickup or accessed with the AXS mobile app. The FAQ does not publish a fixed pickup time for will-call orders.

gates.summary: Guests and bags are subject to search or wanding at entry. General admission permits standing-room access to the showroom on concert nights; reserved tickets include an assigned seat.
